messages:
Ethan M.: Heads up — prospects (Healthsy) asked for a POC evidence bundle + signed pen-test attestation. Also asked if Dedicated pricing applies for a 10-day POC. Need plan.
Priya R.: Do they require VPC/private or is hosted okay? That will change artifact sensitivity & timing.
Ethan M.: On the discovery they said hosted preferred but "may need dedicated" if compliance team insists. Goal = 10 business days, ~40k tokens/day.
Sam L.: I'll prepare a lean proofpack: redacted SOC2 Type II excerpt, ISO cert, pen-test attestation template, high-level network diagram, KMS flow, logging/retention table, data residency note.
Jules (Legal): We should require an NDA before sharing unredacted docs. Pen-test letter: we can provide our standard vendor-attested template for signature. If they insist on vendor report, we can provide an attestation only unless vendor approval to re-share.
Priya R.: Note: if they want Dedicated for the POC we need infra lead time and a minimal monthly reservation. Short POC usually cheaper to run hosted. I can produce a hosted cost est and Dedicated 1-month equivalent by EOD.
Ethan M.: Customer prefers presigned S3 or SFTP. Contact is techops@healthsy.io.
ProvisionBot: Evidence staging bucket created: s3://rw-evidence-healthsy-1746032100 — presigned upload links valid 72h (owner: sam.l).
Sam L.: I'll upload draft proofpack and include redact guidance. Will mark which docs require NDA.
Ethan M.: Also confirm whether they can accept redacted SOC2 and the pen-test attestation in lieu of full vendor report.
Priya R.: Pricing note to include: Hosted = usage charges; Dedicated = reserved capacity + min 1-month commit. Offer hosted POC + temporary burst Dedicated demo to show throughput without month commit.
Jules (Legal): I'll review pen-test attestation copy before it's sent. If customer asks vendor signatory, we need vendor contact info.
Sam L.: Uploaded: evidence/readme.txt, evidence/soc2-excerpt.pdf, evidence/iso27001.pdf, evidence/pen-test-attestation-template.pdf. Link in bucket.
Ethan M.: I'll call Healthsy tomorrow to clarify on-prem vs aspirational. If they insist on private, loop Eng-platform & security for scoping — timeline will stretch.
Priya R.: I'll post the cost breakdown in thread by 1746032155.
Ethan M.: Target: if hosted accepted, get signed pen-test letter + evidence ZIP to them within 48-72h post-call.
